descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S14 「两个模式下，口述中途和点 AI 步骤的那一刻离线，然后网络回来：有提示，文字保留，没有一直转的加载圈，重新连上后存下来」 Offline mid-dictation and at the moment of an AI step, then back online, in both contexts: message, text kept, nothing spinning forever, saved after reconnect

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear "no network" message; the dictation is kept and retried when the connection returns (OAT-03).（UAT EFS state 9；TFA-94745 state 9；TFA-92568 Eng 4）
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state.（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 3）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android.（UAT EFS Expected Result；UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Standard fixture, chart open on the Encounter tab

When Type line one and wait for it to save; the harness takes the browser offline; type line two; tap Generate Note & Finish; open Ask AI and ask; type a pre-round line and tap Save Note; the harness brings the network back; tap Save Note once more (the message's next step); …

Then While offline a clear no-network message shows, it says the work saves when the connection returns, and every typed text stays on screen; each AI step tapped offline settles on a message within 20 s instead of spinning; after reconnect the message goes and after reload the typed text is on the server. No note is generated twice

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U9/U13 and the state 9 row literally: offline checkpoints mustContain 'no network', the typed text and a next-step phrase about the connection returning; each AI step tapped offline (Generate, Ask, Save Note) mustContain its text and a message 20 s after the tap and mustNotContain its busy label ('Generating Note', 'Searching', 'Saving & Updating'); …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
